Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Hey,

a big thank you for the final table one last time! It was a blast to play, even though a bit one-sided in the end. Not everything was super story-liney, but it made for a super interesting and eventful story ark.

I'll try to have some time to write a bit of a fluffy piece about the whole AoC tournament from my perspective. Maybe before June. Hopefully.

Basically I brought the wrong vampire up. I couldn't find my merge pieces for Danielle (basic), and I didn't have enough time afterwards to counter Batlimore Purge's really bad outcome. Brunhilde was graverobbed, and my weenies didn't have enough blood to keep playing Friend of Mines that clogged my hand as I went down. It was a close call. But no cigar.

This is NOT the deck I played, but rather a bit streamlined version of it based on my experiences with it after AoC and Shadow Twin. You'll get the idea though. On friday I had a bit more wacky stuff in there.

www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?deck=view&id=24365
